eyebrow: BSON: Binary JSON, not text JSON
code:
JSON types:  string, number, boolean,
             null, array, object

BSON adds:   Date, ObjectId, BinData,
             Int32, Int64, Decimal128
caption: Every field is type- and length-prefixed — a real, richer type system.

caption: ObjectId, Date, and Decimal128 — none of these exist in plain JSON.
